ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, A1 is drawn in the form of a differential amplifier/operational amplifier, and the input signal ui is connected through resistor R to the positive input terminal “+” of A1. The output terminal of A1 is on the right, labeled u0. The output terminal is connected downward to resistor R1; the lower end of R1 is connected to the upper end of resistor Rf, and the lower end of Rf is grounded. The connection node of R1 and Rf is also connected back through a feedback line to the negative input terminal “-” of A1. Then reason: Since Rf is located in the output loop, below R1 and connected toward ground, when the output-branch current flows through this loop, it will produce a feedback voltage on Rf; therefore the quantity sampled by the feedback is related to the output current, belonging to current sampling. This feedback voltage is sent to the inverting input terminal of the operational amplifier and is subtracted from the input signal applied to the non-inverting input terminal, so it plays the role of canceling the input and is negative feedback. The feedback signal is compared in series at the input terminal through differential input, rather than shunting the input source in parallel, so the mixing method is series. Conclusion: Rf provides current-series negative feedback.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: identify A1 as a differential amplifier/op-amp, with the signal applied to the + input and the feedback node tied to the - input. Trace the output branch and note that Rf lies in series below R1 in the return path to ground, so the load/output current produces a feedback voltage across Rf. Therefore the sampled output quantity is current. Since that voltage is returned to the inverting input, it opposes the input signal, so the feedback is negative. Because the feedback is combined at the input through the differential/series input comparison rather than by shunting the source node, classify the mixing as series. Conclude: current-series negative feedback.

再推理：由于 Rf 位于输出回路中、在 R1 下方并接向地，输出支路电流流过该回路时会在 Rf 上产生反馈电压，因此反馈采样的量与输出电流有关，属于电流取样。该反馈电压被送到运算放大器的反相输入端，与加在同相输入端的输入信号相减，所以它起抵消输入的作用，为负反馈。反馈信号在输入端通过差分输入进行串联比较，而不是并联分流输入源，因此混合方式为串联。结论：Rf 提供电流串联负反馈。
